subject: AWS Marketplace Private Offer — invoicing & commission routing for BrickLane
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Kyle Rogers <kyle@bricklane-resell.com>, Janie Soto <janie.soto@bricklane-resell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace Private Offer — next steps and invoicing questions

Hi Kyle / Janie,

Thanks for the call today — great to see momentum on BrickLane's pilot. Per our discussion I wanted to capture a few open items before we start the CPPO submission to AWS:

- Confirm whether BrickLane will sign via a reseller PO (BrickLane pays reseller) or require Redwood to invoice BrickLane directly (we prefer reseller routing for marketplace GL alignment).
- If reseller routing, confirm the commission split and whether BrickLane needs a formal reseller invoice flow or needs Redwood to create a consolidated invoice for marketplace credits.
- Attachment: RDW-BRL-CPPO-SOW-v2.pdf (SOW with pilot specs).

Ben, looping you in to surface billing/cart constraints.

Proposed next step: If BrickLane confirms reseller routing we ask AWS CPPO to create the Private Offer targeted at BrickLane's AWS account and map the reseller entitlement. If BrickLane prefers direct invoice, we'll need a short procurement addendum.

Cheers,
Mina Haddad
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

--- attachment: RDW-BRL-CPPO-SOW-v2.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Kyle Rogers <kyle@bricklane-resell.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Janie Soto <janie.soto@bricklane-resell.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace Private Offer — next steps and invoicing questions

Hi Mina — thanks for summing this up. Short answers:

- BrickLane will have a reseller-led procurement: they want invoices from BrickLane (reseller) rather than Redwood.
- Commission split agreed in principle is 18% net to BrickLane (we can finalize the channel carve-out in the reseller agreement).

I've attached our standard reseller SOW mark (we made a few edits to your RDW SOW in comments). Also attaching Janie's contact for procurement coordination.

We'll need the CPPO to reflect reseller as the Seller of Record so BrickLane can generate the invoice and claim the marketplace credit/commission.

Thanks,
Kyle Rogers
Head of Channel, BrickLane Resell
kyle@bricklane-resell.com
+1 (212) 555-0144

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace Private Offer — next steps and invoicing questions

Hi team,

Two operational notes from finance/ops I want to surface before we instruct AWS CPPO:

1) Invoice flow sketch: if BrickLane will issue the invoice to the end customer we need a clear mapping of the offer line-items to SKU/usage metrics so BrickLane's accounting can reconcile marketplace credits. I sketched a simple flow (attached).
2) PO and billing name: please confirm whether BrickLane's customer will provide a PO to BrickLane or to Redwood; that changes which account is listed on the CPPO.

If we're changing Seller of Record we also need a short reseller addendum (2 paragraphs) covering tax handling and credit management. Vanessa — can you weigh in on the wording below?

Thanks,
Ben
Revenue Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
--- attachment: invoice_flow_sketch.png (image/png)
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Kyle Rogers <kyle@bricklane-resell.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, AWS CPPO Team <aws-cppo+redwood@amazon.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace Private Offer — invoicing addendum and legal touchpoints

Thanks Ben — quick legal summary and required fields for the CPPO / addendum: 

- Reseller addendum (2 paragraphs) will state: (a) Seller of Record assignment to BrickLane for the Private Offer; (b) Redwood retains right to audit usage reports for credit reconciliation; (c) tax handling is passed through to BrickLane and invoicing disputes go through BrickLane customer support with Redwood in cc for escalations.
- CPPO metadata we need from AWS: SellerOfRecord field, ResellerOrgID, MarketplaceProductID, effectiveStartDate, and routing for invoice notifications.
- DocuSign: we'll route the addendum via DocuSign; please confirm signatories (BrickLane legal + Redwood VP Finance).

AWS CPPO team — can you confirm whether SellerOfRecord is a supported mapping for BrickLane's reseller account when you create the Private Offer? If you need a reseller PayerId we can share BrickLane's Marketplace Org ID once they confirm.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
--- attachment: RDW-reseller-addendum-draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)
From: AWS CPPO Team <aws-cppo+redwood@amazon.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Kyle Rogers <kyle@bricklane-resell.com>, Marketplace Ops <mp-ops@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 13:10:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: AWS Marketplace Private Offer — invoicing addendum and legal touchpoints

Hi Vanessa / Mina / Ben —

Confirmed: SellerOfRecord can be set to BrickLane provided the reseller has an active Marketplace Seller record and we receive the ResellerOrgID. Steps we recommend: 

1) BrickLane to provide Marketplace Org ID (ResellerOrgID) and seller contact.
2) Redwood to upload the Private Offer draft (we can accept the DocuSign addendum PDF as supplemental documentation).
3) AWS will map the SellerOfRecord field to the Private Offer on creation and enable invoice routing to BrickLane.

We have created a DocuSign PowerForm for the reseller addendum to speed signatures: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=prod&acct=12345&pfId=abc-7421

Please complete the DocuSign and reply here once BrickLane confirms ResellerOrgID. Once received we will provision the CPPO and share MarketplaceProductID for the Private Offer.

Regards,
AWS CPPO Team
aws-cppo+redwood@amazon.com

Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 16:24:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: AWS Marketplace Private Offer — invoicing addendum and legal touchpoints

Thanks everyone — quick checklist from Redwood side to close the loop:

- Kyle / Janie: please send BrickLane ResellerOrgID and confirm signatory for DocuSign (usually legal lead + head of finance).
- BrickLane to sign DocuSign (link above).
- Ben / Vanessa: once DocuSign is signed Redwood will upload the final addendum and SOW to AWS with request to set SellerOfRecord = BrickLane and include the invoice routing metadata.
- Rishi: please prepare a short internal playbook (2 bullets) for Customer Success on how to handle invoice disputes/credits with reseller path.

If we can get the OrgID and signatures by EOD Wednesday we can have the CPPO provisioned by next week and target a pilot start the week of Apr 26.

Thanks — Mina
